title: Blues Jam @ Kenny Dorham's Backyard
event_description: East Austin's Blue Monday is a 25+ year outdoor blues jam. Players singers dancers and listeners welcome. BYOB food trucks and a $5–$10 suggested donation.
event_venue_information:
Kenny Dorham's Backyard

East Austin outdoor music legacy

Kenny Dorham's Backyard is an East Austin outdoor music space run with DiverseArts programming. Blue Monday Blues Jam has drawn players and neighbors for more than twenty-five years with a relaxed BYOB and food-truck vibe.

The yard also hosts the monthly Jazz OUTside series with a free jam after the featured set. Blankets chairs and all-ages listening fit the neighborhood hang. Suggested donations keep the tradition going.

Expect roots jazz blues and community energy under the East Austin sky — not a downtown club polish but a true local jam culture.

title: Jazz Jam @ The Elephant Room
event_description: Michael Mordecai's Monday jazz jam has been an Austin fixture for decades. Sit in with house rhythm and surprise guests at this downtown basement jazz club.
event_venue_information:
The Elephant Room

Downtown Austin jazz basement

The Elephant Room is Austin's long-running downtown jazz club on Congress Avenue. Intimate stage sightlines and a serious listening crowd make it a training ground for local jazz players.

Michael Mordecai has hosted the Monday jazz jam since 1980 and at the Elephant Room since 1991. Unpredictable guests and a classic sit-in format keep Mondays essential.

Come ready to listen first then sit in with respect for the house band and the room.

title: Open Mic @ The Buzz Mill
event_description: Riverside Monday music open mic for local musicians singers and songwriters. Acoustic-friendly night resumed by popular demand with hosts from Coffin Fits.
event_venue_information:
The Buzz Mill

Riverside 24-hour cafe and music hang

The Buzz Mill on Town Creek Drive is a Riverside Austin cafe known for late hours community events and a welcoming stage for acoustic players.

Monday Music Open Mic brings songwriters and singers together with in-person signup at 7:00 PM and music from 8:00 to 10:00 PM. Bring your acoustic guitar and originals or classics.

It is a low-pressure neighborhood mic with hosts who know the local scene.

title: Folk Open Mic @ Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches
event_description: AFTM folk and traditional music open mic on the fourth Monday each month. Fiddles mandolins and voices welcome; free with a tip bucket.
event_venue_information:
Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches

East Austin community jam hub

Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches on Manor Road is one of Austin's densest open-stage addresses. Bluegrass jazz classical folk choro and monthly open mics share the same friendly brewery floor.

AFTM's fourth-Monday open mic leans folk and traditional with a wide mix of musicians. Bring instruments or voices; the night is free and tip-friendly.

If you want one venue that maps Austin's participatory music week Batch is the place to start.

title: Classical Jam @ Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches
event_description: Open chamber music reading night for Austin classical musicians. Collaborative and free; bring your parts and instruments.
event_venue_information:
Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches

East Austin community jam hub

Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches hosts Classical Jams as an open chamber reading night. Austin classical players collaborate in a brewery setting that feels welcoming rather than formal.

Monthly Monday listings put the reading from 8:00 to 10:00 PM. All are welcome to play; bring your own parts.

It is a rare classical open jam nested inside Batch's broader week of bluegrass jazz and folk stages.

title: Songwriters Open Mic @ Cactus Cafe
event_description: Free weekly original-music-only songwriter night on the historic Cactus Cafe stage. Covers not allowed; contact the host to get on the list.
venue_address: 2308 Whitis Ave Texas Union Austin TX 78712
event_venue_information:
Cactus Cafe

Historic UT listening room

Cactus Cafe inside the Texas Union is one of Austin's most respected songwriter rooms. The Tuesday Songwriters Open Mic keeps that craft focus with original music only.

Host Jake Farr runs a free weekly night aligned with the academic calendar. Contact him ahead of time to perform; doors often open around 7:00 PM with the show near 7:30.

Expect a quiet listening crowd and a stage that still carries Austin songwriter history.

title: Open Mic @ Mozart's Coffee Roasters
event_description: Late at the Lake is a lakeside outdoor open mic prioritizing original song debuts. Music and poetry share sheets; typically 35–40 performers.
event_time_plain: Sign-up 7:30 PM - 8:00 PM; show 8:00 PM - 11:00 PM
backline: No communal guitar; no drum set; handheld percussion OK; max trio
sign_up_sheet: Separate sheets for originals covers and poetry
event_venue_information:
Mozart's Coffee Roasters

Lakeside deck open mic

Mozart's on Lake Austin Boulevard is famous for the outdoor deck and the weekly Late at the Lake open mic. Original debuts get priority with separate signup sheets for songs covers and poetry.

Rules keep the night manageable: one piece about five to six minutes; ages 16+; no backing tracks; no full drum set. The lakeside setting draws large performer lists most Tuesdays.

Email music@mozartscoffee.com with questions; show up early for signup.

title: Blues Jam @ Regal Rooms
event_description: Brecks Blues is a two-decade collaborative blues jam now at Regal Rooms. House band Silver Alert provides pro backline for blues R&B and classic rock sit-ins.
backline: Guitar amps bass amp drums keys
event_venue_information:
Regal Rooms

South Austin Event Center blues jam home

Regal Rooms on Regal Row hosts Brecks Blues — a long-running collaborative jam that is about playing together not solo showcases.

Doors and signup open at 7:30 PM with house band warm-up then open jam until 11:00 PM. Admission is free or pay-what-you-want. Professional backline is provided.

South Austin players looking for a real blues hang will feel at home here.

title: Open Mic @ Lucky Rabbit
event_description: Inclusive acoustic open mic for songwriters and vocalists in the Lake Travis area. Host Chris Slone accompanies singers who do not play.
event_venue_information:
Lucky Rabbit

Jonestown Lake Travis acoustic stage

Lucky Rabbit brings greater Austin and Lake Travis songwriters a welcoming Tuesday open mic. Host Chris Slone supports vocalists who need accompaniment.

The night runs roughly 6:00 to 9:00 PM with originals and covers welcome. Professional sound keeps the focus on songs not gear stress.

A strong option if you want Hill Country and lake-area stages beyond downtown.

title: Old Time Jam @ Austin Old Time Jam
event_description: Weekly old-time traditional jam hosted by Britt Irick. Location varies; check the AFTM calendar or Facebook group. All skill levels welcome.
venue_address: Location varies weekly; check AFTM calendar
sign_up_sheet: Drop-in jam; free to listen or learn
event_venue_information:
Austin Old Time Jam

Rotating weekly traditional jam

Austin Old Time Jam is a weekly drop-in circle for old-time and traditional repertoire. Host Britt Irick and AFTM announcements keep the location current — sometimes Wheatsville and other friendly rooms.

Tuesdays run about 6:00 to 9:00 PM. All skill levels can listen learn or play. Bring acoustic instruments and curiosity.

Confirm the week's address on the AFTM series page or the Austin Old Time Jam Facebook group before you go.

title: Open Mic @ Poodies Roadhouse
event_description: No Bad Days Wednesday open mic carries Poodie Locke's Hill Country spirit. Country Americana and songwriter sets with no fee to play.
backline: Roadhouse stage; bring instrument or band
event_venue_information:
Poodies Roadhouse

Spicewood Hill Country songwriter roadhouse

Poodies Hilltop Roadhouse is a storied Hill Country stage with deep Willie-era and Texas songwriter history. Wednesday No Bad Days open mic keeps that spirit alive.

Sign up around 7:30 PM; music usually starts near 8:00 PM. Rotating hosts and no fee to play make it a working musicians' night.

Worth the drive from Austin if you want roadhouse Americana rather than downtown polish.

title: Open Mic @ Opa Greek Cafe
event_description: Weekly South Lamar open mic for music art and poetry in a Greek cafe and wine bar setting. Stage open to all with in-person signup.
event_venue_information:
Opa Greek Cafe

South Lamar cafe open mic

Opa Greek Cafe (Opa Coffee & Wine Bar) on South Lamar hosts a weekly Wednesday open mic with a warm cafe-bar atmosphere.

Signups begin about 6:30 PM with performances from 7:00 to 10:00 PM. Music is welcome alongside art and poetry — a friendly neighborhood foothold on the Austin map.

Already known to Open Jam Events readers; times stay consistent for walk-up performers.

title: Open Mic @ Tulum Botanical Bar
event_description: Music-dedicated Wednesday open mic for acoustic vocals experimental and live-looping sets. Free live demo recording of your set is part of the draw.
event_venue_information:
Tulum Botanical Bar

East 7th music open mic

Tulum Botanical Bar on East 7th runs a weekly music-focused open mic with underground-scene energy. Acoustic vocals experimental sets and live looping all fit.

Sign up from 7:00 PM with performances from 8:00 toward 11:00 PM. The venue highlights free live demo recording and occasional livestream or podcast capture.

A strong East Austin option if you want a mic aimed at musicians first.

title: Jazz Jam @ Monks Jazz Club
event_description: Late-night Wednesday jazz jam hosted by Daniel Dufour. No cover with a one-drink minimum; bring your instrument and sit in.
venue_address: 310 E. Saint Elmo Rd Austin TX
event_venue_information:
Monks Jazz Club

South Austin late-night jazz

Monks Jazz Club on Saint Elmo Road is a dedicated jazz room with ticketed shows and a weekly Wednesday jam.

Doors and jam start around 9:00 PM running toward midnight. Host Daniel Dufour anchors most weeks; guest hosts appear occasionally. No cover; one-drink minimum at the full-service bar.

Bring your horn or axe and be ready for a real late-night sit-in.

title: Bluegrass Open Mic @ New World Deli
event_description: Eddie Collins hosts a long-running monthly bluegrass open mic. Old-time welcome; show up with acoustic instruments on the second Thursday.
event_venue_information:
New World Deli

Guadalupe Street bluegrass room

New World Deli on Guadalupe hosts Eddie Collins's Bluegrass Open Mic through the Austin Friends of Traditional Music calendar.

Second Thursdays from 7:00 to 9:00 PM lean bluegrass with old-time welcome. Bring acoustic instruments and expect a friendly picking crowd.

A monthly must for Central Austin traditional players.

title: Jazz Jam @ Kenny Dorham's Backyard
event_description: Jazz OUTside pairs a featured outdoor set with Austin's long-running free jazz jam. All ages; blankets and BYOB welcome on third Thursdays.
event_time_plain: Doors 7:30 PM; show 8:00 PM - 9:00 PM; jam 9:00 PM - 10:00 PM
backline: Outdoor; BYOB; bring what you need
event_venue_information:
Kenny Dorham's Backyard

East Austin outdoor music legacy

Jazz OUTside at Kenny Dorham's Backyard is a monthly outdoor series with a featured band then a free jazz jam. Listings call it among the longest-running free jazz jams of its kind in Austin.

Third Thursdays: doors about 7:30 PM; show 8:00–9:00; jam 9:00–10:00. Suggested donation keeps the yard programming; all ages welcome.

Pair it with Blue Monday for a full East Austin outdoor week.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches
event_description: CTBA Sunday Bluegrass Jam has run weekly since 1978. Drop-in pickers and listeners fill Batch Sunday afternoons — a Chronicle Best of 2026 pick.
event_venue_information:
Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches

East Austin community jam hub

The CTBA Sunday Bluegrass Jam at Batch is weekly since 1978 and still one of Austin's surest acoustic hangs. Afternoons run 1:00 to 4:00 PM for pickers and listeners alike.

Austin Chronicle Best of 2026 recognized it as a top place to fiddle around. No ego gatekeeping — just bluegrass community.

Stay later on second and fourth Sundays for Golden Hour Jazz Jam at the same address.

title: Jazz Jam @ Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches
event_description: Golden Hour Jazz Jam with The Goulds on second and fourth Sundays. Bring your axe or listen through the late afternoon brewery set.
event_venue_information:
Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches

East Austin community jam hub

Golden Hour Jazz Jam is Batch's legendary weekend jazz hang hosted by The Goulds with occasional special guests.

Second and fourth Sundays from 4:00 to 7:00 PM. Bring an instrument or grab a seat and listen. It pairs perfectly after the CTBA bluegrass afternoon.

One more reason Batch anchors East Austin participatory jazz.

title: Open Mic with Tyler and Chris @ Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches
event_description: Supportive monthly music open mic with hosts Tyler and Chris. Originals or covers; all ages and skill levels. Sign up via Google Form linked from Batch.
sign_up: Google Form signup via Batch calendar
event_venue_information:
Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches

East Austin community jam hub

The Open Mic with Tyler and Chris closes out Batch months on the last Sunday evening. It is framed as encouraging for all ages and skill levels.

Sign up through the Google Form linked from the Batch events calendar. Sets run about 7:30 to 9:00 PM with originals or covers welcome.

A gentle entry point if daytime bluegrass or jazz jams feel intense.

title: Open Mic @ ATXM Night Shift
event_description: Austin Texas Musicians industry mixer with lottery open mic for musicians. Free monthly hang; RSVP then draw from the hat near the stage.
venue_address: Rotating venues; e.g. Hotel Vegas 1502 E 6th St Austin TX 78702
sign_up: RSVP required; lottery open mic on arrival
event_venue_information:
ATXM Night Shift

Rotating industry mixer with lottery open mic

Austin Texas Musicians (ATXM) runs Night Shift as a free monthly music-industry mixer with a lottery open mic. Musicians venues producers and nonprofits mingle then names are drawn to play.

Generally first Tuesdays from 7:00 to 10:00 PM with music from 8:00. Venues rotate — Hotel Vegas on East 6th is a recent example. RSVP through ATXM then enter the lottery on arrival.

Ideal if you want stage time plus scene connections in one night.

title: Choro Jam @ Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches
event_description: Austin Choro Club roda de choro after the Caros Amigos set. Brazilian choro circle open to community players of all ages and instruments.
event_venue_information:
Batch Craft Beer & Kolaches

East Austin community jam hub

Austin Choro Club hosts a roda de choro at Batch on third Saturdays following the Caros Amigos set. Brazilian choro repertoire in a welcoming circle format.

Afternoon timing often lands near 2:00 PM after an earlier featured set. All ages and instruments are invited to join the community jam.

Check carosamigosmusic.com/austin-choro-club and the Batch calendar for the month's exact start.
